# Release 0.2.4

Published the publishable `@ontrails/*` package set at `0.2.4` on the `latest` dist-tag.

## Highlights

- Report a directory that disappears between listing and reading as `vanished-directory` instead of `unreadable-directory` in `collectSourceTree`. Permission and other read failures still report `unreadable-directory`. Static project identity discovery now rescans, up to three attempts, when a directory vanishes mid-walk. A removed directory, such as a parallel test's temp dir, drops out of the next listing, and a renamed one, including one holding a `trails.config.*` marker, is found under its new path. Churn that outlasts the retries still fails closed. Regrade also fails closed on both reasons, because a vanished directory may have been renamed and its sources would otherwise escape a prepared run or apply.
- Accept GitHub stacked-PR merge evidence for `publish:auto`. A merged changeset source PR now earns trusted source evidence when its REST resource carries a GitHub `stack` object and required CI passed on its head SHA or merge SHA, recorded as `GitHub stack #N and required CI passed on <sha>`. Graphite merge-queue evidence and the `stack:boundary` label work as before. Standalone PRs and any unreadable or unrecognized response still fail closed to `publish:manual`.
- Retry transient GitHub API failures in release policy reads. `githubJson` now retries 5xx responses and network errors up to four attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) before failing, so an intermittent `500` from `/commits/{sha}/pulls` no longer fails the Release workflow's `label-release-pr` step. 4xx responses still fail immediately.

## Changes

- [`b155fde`](https://github.com/outfitter-dev/trails/commit/b155fde9aa271ead2e76d675f2d281e28c9289f4): Report a directory that disappears between listing and reading as `vanished-directory` instead of `unreadable-directory` in `collectSourceTree`. Permission and other read failures still report `unreadable-directory`. Static project identity discovery now rescans, up to three attempts, when a directory vanishes mid-walk. A removed directory, such as a parallel test's temp dir, drops out of the next listing, and a renamed one, including one holding a `trails.config.*` marker, is found under its new path. Churn that outlasts the retries still fails closed. Regrade also fails closed on both reasons, because a vanished directory may have been renamed and its sources would otherwise escape a prepared run or apply. Packages: `@ontrails/config`, `@ontrails/regrade`, `@ontrails/source`
- [`cfeb154`](https://github.com/outfitter-dev/trails/commit/cfeb1547c9f866f34f94ff50c4a154d3638bb8b1): Accept GitHub stacked-PR merge evidence for `publish:auto`. A merged changeset source PR now earns trusted source evidence when its REST resource carries a GitHub `stack` object and required CI passed on its head SHA or merge SHA, recorded as `GitHub stack #N and required CI passed on <sha>`. Graphite merge-queue evidence and the `stack:boundary` label work as before. Standalone PRs and any unreadable or unrecognized response still fail closed to `publish:manual`. Packages: `@ontrails/trails`
- [`53ed05f`](https://github.com/outfitter-dev/trails/commit/53ed05fca576e0a4292133d035eb77eabc601dc9): Retry transient GitHub API failures in release policy reads. `githubJson` now retries 5xx responses and network errors up to four attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) before failing, so an intermittent `500` from `/commits/{sha}/pulls` no longer fails the Release workflow's `label-release-pr` step. 4xx responses still fail immediately.
